name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A rulebook and toolkit that makes a coding AI slow down, plan properly, and test its work before shipping — like giving a junior engineer a senior engineer's checklist.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small dev shop who wants every developer's AI coding sessions to follow the same disciplined process (spec first, tests first) instead of ad-hoc vibes.
business_use_cases: A dev agency installs it across every client project so AI-written code consistently gets planned, reviewed, and tested the same way regardless of which developer is driving.
A solo indie hacker uses it to let their coding agent work unattended for hours on a feature without drifting off the agreed plan.
A CTO uses it as an onboarding standard so every new hire's AI agent behaves predictably from day one.

money_ideas.idea: The maintainers already offer paid enterprise support and managed spending for companies adopting it — a smaller shop could resell that as implementation consulting.
Build and sell an industry-specific skill pack (e.g. for fintech compliance code review) that plugs into the same skill system.

steal_this: Install it on a real client project this weekend and sell the 'we ship with a disciplined AI process' pitch as a premium tier over normal freelance dev rates.
